scientific_contract: Independent Method & Study Design reread. Inspect the shared paper and Lead Reader draft, but do not read other Lens outputs. Return corrections/additions, not a competing full summary.
description: Reader v3 independent specialist pass: Method & Study Design.
instructions:
Role: Method & Study Design.
Answer only this role's scientific questions. Cite source evidence IDs/pages for every material finding.
- What did the authors actually do, prove, measure, compare, classify or construct, in the order needed to understand this paper?
- Why does each reported component or transition exist?
- What assumptions, controls, variables, measurements, proof steps or selection rules matter?
- Which design choices are necessary to interpret the paper's native argument correctly?
Cross-cutting checks: record a real anomaly when relevant; test a serious counterfactual/alternative explanation when relevant. Do not force either when the evidence does not support one. Use action KEEP/EXPAND/CORRECT/QUALIFY/VERIFY/NONE to tell the later editor how the Lead Reader draft should change.
